skills.name: lambda-standards
skills.description: Runtime rules for Node.js/TypeScript AWS Lambda functions — handler as composition root, module-scope SDK clients, env validation, idempotency for retried SQS/EventBridge events, partial batch failures, timeouts, memory and structured logging. Use when writing or reviewing a Lambda handler or event consumer, or when asked about "cold starts", "lambda timeout", "retries" or "duplicate events".

skills.name: llm-functions
skills.description: Structure backend functions that call LLMs — one unit per model call with a port, schema, prompt and test; versioned prompt ids with fallbacks; multi-stage pipelines with a time budget and bounded concurrency; required vs optional stages; async jobs for slow work; token tracking and privacy. Use when adding or changing a Lambda or service that calls an LLM, writing a prompt, building an AI generation pipeline, or when AI output is malformed or a generation times out.
